paragraphs.text: Belenon was introduced on two Planechase 2012 cards: Windriddle Palaces , which shows complex architecture towers, and Edge of Malacol , showing beasts and spherical landscapes.
The plane was a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion .

Belenon is an animal humanoid plane where all the creatures are some kind of "animal person", except for the plane's humans. The three shown in the art are Loxodon (elephants), Rhox (rhinos), and Aven (birds).

The people believe in a concept called the Sacred Winds . Many of them are organised in knightly orders. One of them is the Royal Knights of Belenon, an organization equally practiced in courtesy, as well as in combat.
